summary: 8 features and 7 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • git-watch: add bounded project git monitoring watch subsystem (128f1d8)
  • haginput: add hagi input message storage and API (87426a5)
  • sessions: support content language in proposal optimization bundle (2ca975e)
  • git-cache: add filesystem watcher and cache freshness to ProjectGitGrain (01e32d3)

HagiCode-org/web

  • git: add monitoring limit and watch status panel (f6caa95)
  • voice: persist remote haginput input messages (ad72d35)
  • proposal: pass content language to description optimization (45d8e69)
  • proposal: disable default plan API response by default (a676bdc)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • prompts: honor requested output language in optimization bundle (f185e06)
  • frontend-config: change default voice recognition provider (bfd1960)

HagiCode-org/web

  • mermaid: scale flowcharts to container with explicit useMaxWidth (f6d9986)
  • preset-task: gate remote create command on form readiness (beca369)
  • mermaid: let diagrams scale to container width (7bb1675)
  • config: skip pre-hydration frontend-config persist (7182eb9)
  • git: load first selected repository detail automatically (17acfc6)
